disallowed.rule: Application orchestration must not depend on command parsing or terminal presentation.
disallowed.remediation: Move the shared logic into src/app, src/policy, src/state, or src/infra and call it from the CLI layer.

disallowed.rule: Bridge runtime code must not import CLI modules.
disallowed.remediation: Move user-facing formatting into src/cli or extract the shared logic into src/policy or src/infra.

disallowed.rule: Bridge internals must not reach back into app orchestration.
disallowed.remediation: Push the orchestration decision upward into src/app or extract a shared helper into src/policy.

disallowed.rule: Policy modules must remain reusable and side-effect free.
disallowed.remediation: Keep prompts, printing, and command parsing in src/cli and expose plain data helpers from src/policy.

disallowed.rule: Policy modules must not depend on app workflows.
disallowed.remediation: Pass the required data into the policy helper or move the use-case orchestration into src/app.

disallowed.rule: Policy modules cannot depend on bridge runtime state.
disallowed.remediation: Extract the pure rule into src/policy and keep hook/runtime side effects in src/bridge.

disallowed.rule: Policy modules cannot import messaging adapters directly.
disallowed.remediation: Pass messaging-specific values as arguments or keep adapter-specific behavior in src/discord or src/slack.

disallowed.rule: Policy modules cannot import runtime implementations directly.
disallowed.remediation: Keep tmux and PTY runtime behavior in src/runtime or src/tmux and expose only pure naming/launch helpers from src/policy.

disallowed.rule: Policy modules cannot import container orchestration code.
disallowed.remediation: Thread container-specific data into the policy function instead of importing container modules.

disallowed.rule: Infrastructure utilities must not depend on command-layer presentation.
disallowed.remediation: Move shared low-level behavior into src/infra and keep chalk/output handling in src/cli.

disallowed.rule: Infrastructure helpers must stay below app orchestration.
disallowed.remediation: Invert the dependency: app code may call infra, but infra must not import app workflows.

disallowed.rule: Infrastructure helpers must not import bridge runtime concerns.
disallowed.remediation: Pass callbacks or plain values into infra utilities instead of importing src/bridge.

disallowed.rule: Infrastructure helpers must not depend on platform adapters.
disallowed.remediation: Keep Discord/Slack specifics in src/discord or src/slack and pass only primitive inputs into infra.

boundaryValidators.remediation: Validate hook request shape in hook-server.ts before dispatching to runtime or event handlers.
Guard runtime control payloads as unknown input at the route boundary before reading fields.
Parse hook events through validateHookEventEnvelope before routing them into bridge handlers.
Sanitize external telemetry payloads at the worker boundary before forwarding to GA4.
